chapter.name: Chapter 537: Came here
chapter.content:
Just as Lin Fei participated in the recruitment assessment of the Tiger Mercenary Corps, a mansion in Longyan City.

This mansion has a magnificent architectural style, and a series of sturdy, imposing warriors enter and exit it.

At the front entrance of this mansion, there is a plaque saying: The Dragon Flame Branch of the True Demon Gate.

These characters are painted with silver hooks and iron, with vigorous brushstrokes, and every character reveals an artistic conception of dominating the world. Every stroke, every stroke, is a set of its own, showing infinite power.

In this place, many warriors in Longyan City knew that it was Heavenly Dragon Holy Kingdom, one of the five major sects, and a stronghold of the True Demon Sect in Longyan City.

now.

The [Liancheng www.wsx5.cn] branch of the True Demon Gate Dragon City.

back yard.

At this time, in the pavilion in the back garden, five or six figures were sitting upright and discussing. Each figure was a stout figure with strong muscles.

"That said, did the kid wanted by our school really show up in Dragon Flame City?"

A man in the middle asked. He was two meters tall and covered with thick black hair, like a bear. His voice sounded strong and he appeared very energetic.

"Yes, Deacon Su, one of the guards of the Dragon Flame City is a disciple of our True Demon Sect.

The portrait of that kid has been spread to every stronghold of our true magic gate nation, so that disciple recognized that kid at a glance. "

A man next to him immediately replied. He has a fair complexion and a pale blue gown. He speaks elegantly and has something to say. He is more than 40 years old and looks like a full-fledged scholar.

This person is the person in charge of the Dragon Flame Branch of the True Demon Sect.

"Well, have you found that kid's foothold?"

Deacon Nasu asked.

"I found it, the kid didn't seem to want to reveal his traces, so he found a very remote courtyard in the city and rented it.

I have sent our disciple to follow him around the clock.

Deacon Su, don't worry, this time, it's hard for that kid to fly his wings in Longyan City. "

The man next to Deacon Su replied.

"Well, Hall Master Zhao, your ability to do things is really good."

Deacon Su nodded in satisfaction.

"Hahaha, well, since we have mastered the trail of that kid, then, without further ado, tonight, go and catch that kid. I will interrogate him personally to see if he breaks into our True Demon Gate headquarters. What an attempt.

Hehe, of course, before the interrogation, all kinds of punishments were imposed on him, so that he could not survive or die.

Only in this way, by killing chickens and respecting monkeys, no one will dare to offend our true magic door in this way. "

Speaking of this, Deacon Su’s eyes flashed with bloodthirsty cruelty. Inadvertently, he stuck out his tongue and licked his lips, showing his brutal and **** nature. He was eager to torture others, which was a kind of to him. pleasure.

"Hehe, Deacon Su is in charge of the punishment in the faction. How dare that kid fall into Deacon Su's hands?

Tonight, I will send a man and horse to set up an encirclement to catch a turtle in an urn, capture the boy alive, and hand it to Deacon Su for interrogation. "

Next to him, Hall Master Zhao had long heard of Deacon Su's cruelty. Seeing his cruel gaze at the moment, he could not help but feel a little palpitating.

"Well, Hall Master Zhao, the matter is left to you."

Deacon Su said with satisfaction.

So, Hall Master Zhao immediately went down to arrange the arrest.

…………

That night, Lin Fei returned to the former rented courtyard.

The former middle-aged waiter turned out to personally give Lin Fei food and drinks, very enthusiastic.

However, Lin Fei noticed that there was a sly look in his eyes from time to time.

Obviously, this guy may have some bad intentions.

Lin Fei couldn't help but smile secretly. If this guy has self-knowledge, it's okay if he doesn't provoke him, otherwise, he will blow into flesh with a punch.

This middle-aged waiter was just a cultivation base of the mid-level of the heavens. Lin Fei wanted to kill him, so he turned his back easily.

The middle-aged waiter brought food and drink to Lin Fei, and he left with a false enthusiasm.

Of course, Lin Fei didn't eat the food delivered by the middle-aged waiter. When his cultivation reached the vitality realm, the martial artist could only absorb the spiritual energy of the heavens and the earth and cultivate the vital energy, which was enough to support the body's necessary energy.

If you don't eat for more than ten days, there will be no problems at all.

However, just after the middle-aged waiter left Banzhuxiang.

Lin Fei suddenly changed his expression and felt murderous.

The divine consciousness was released, and soon, more than a dozen figures appeared in the perception of divine consciousness, and the dozens of figures continued to surround him, encircling Lin Fei in groups.

There are 13 figures in total.

After a while, thirteen figures suddenly appeared.

"Boy, you must fasten your hands, otherwise, kill you!"

A man in the lead said that he was about 30 years old, his face was full of flesh, his skin was dark and shiny.

"Oh?

Bound your hands?

Who are you guys? "

Lin Fei was taken aback, and couldn't figure out the identity of the person at all.

But soon, Lin Fei thought of the Eagle Mercenary Group. He killed a new member of the Eagle Mercenary Group with his fist in public today. Could it be that the other party found his residence so quickly and sent someone to retaliate.

Lin Fei's gaze quickly saw that the middle-aged waiter standing behind couldn't help but suddenly, it seemed that it must be the middle-aged waiter who had leaked his whereabouts.

"You were sent by the Eagle Mercenary Corps?"

Lin Fei asked with a smile.

"Boy, don't ask so much, just tie it up obediently."

The dozens of figures gathered around.

"Haha, do you rely on you?"

Lin Fei said with disdain.

"Arrogant, try with my punch!"

Lin Fei's words made the dozen or so people furious, and immediately one of them slammed on the ground, and the violent force stepped out of the ground into a torn apart concave mud pit.

Then, his body leaped like a beast, and he bounced directly towards Lin Fei, slammed in mid-air with a fist, pressing the air in front of him to a real sound.

The fierce and powerful fist wind made Lin Fei's eyes shrink.

This guy's fist power is at least 60,000 catties!

Lin Fei suddenly flashed in his mind and suddenly realized.

I know!

These people turned out to be people from the real magic door!

It seemed that I was in the headquarters of the True Demon Sect before, and the people of the True Demon Sect would not let him go easily. Now they are sending someone to arrest him.

However, Lin Fei is not a kind-hearted person. He has gone through so many setbacks and persecutions after he reborn. Knowing that in this world, it is useless to reason. Only the fist is the most useful reason.

Therefore, in Lin Fei's character, some cruel and cruel factors have naturally developed.

"Hmph, what about the true magic door, if I provoke me, I still kill him!"

Lin Fei came up fiercely, regardless of the three or seventy-one, the murderous intent in his heart sprouted, his thoughts turned, his feet kicked on the ground, the whole person jumped like a projectile, his body shape was snatched out, and a punch was directly blocked.

Fist to fist, this is the most primitive and savage style of play!
